subject.title: [Feature Request] Telegram Channel: Support Thread Binding for Subagent Sessions

question: Should Telegram expose explicit child forum-topic subagent session spawns for `sessions_spawn(thread:true, mode:"session")`, or should Telegram remain current-topic only by default?
rationale: Current main has the low-level Telegram binding adapter and a current-topic default, while related open work argues both for deliberate topic-per-subagent workflows and against user-visible internal subagent topic proliferation.

options.title: Approve Explicit Child-Topic Spawn
options.body: Sponsor a narrow Telegram capability that permits deliberate subagent child forum topics while preserving current-topic behavior for ordinary Telegram binding.

options.title: Keep Telegram Current-Topic Only
options.body: Reject user-visible child-topic subagent spawning for now and close or redirect the direct implementation candidate toward current-topic binding only.

options.title: Defer To Broader Threading Policy
options.body: Block this issue on the broader channel threading policy work before deciding Telegram-specific exposure.

recommendation.title: Approve Explicit Child-Topic Spawn
recommendation.body: Sponsor a narrow Telegram capability that permits deliberate subagent child forum topics while preserving current-topic behavior for ordinary Telegram binding.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision extends the core thread-binding architecture he authored and must fit the post-`subagent_spawning` ownership model.
